name: electron v44.7.2
body:
# Release Notes for v44.7.2

## Fixes

* Fixed an issue where clicks posted to a background app were dropped on macOS. [#54819](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54819) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54818))</sup>
* Fixed interrupted macOS updates leaving a broken app behind. [#54844](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54844) <sup>(Also in [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54843))</sup>

## Other Changes

* Backported fixes from upstream ANGLE, Chromium, PDFium and V8. [#54898](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54898)

## Documentation

 * Documentation changes: [#54880](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54880)
